name: American Museum of Magic
description:
American Museum of Magic
Presto-Change-O! From saloon to billiard parlor, to clothing store, to bakery, to museum, this edifice, built in 1868, has known many transformations. Since April Fools’ Day 1978 it has housed a unique collection that celebrates the magician’s arts of wonder and delight. Michigan’s link to magic is no illusion for nearby Colon, a center of magic manufacturing, which was once home to famed magician Harry Blackstone Sr. (1885-1965), whose memorabilia is displayed here.
